items.title: After LeBron James left, Rob Pelinka said the Lakers had three goals for the offseason:
items.author: Edwin Garcia
items.body_excerpt:
After LeBron James left, Rob Pelinka said the Lakers had three goals for the offseason:
1. Retain Austin Reaves
2. Acquire a center 
3. And players who can dribble, pass, and shoot.

He feels they accomplished all three.
